items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: It's the way Quentin Clinton Jackson looked from behind, spilling over the side of the seat.

ctx.x: Oh, he's very busy with those cards.

Oh, he's quite an artist. I -- one of the -- one set of drawings made an impression on me, I'll never forget, and I keep asking him, you know, 'Where are they?' Duke was rehearsing at [Lewisohn] Stadium, and this was 1958, and I was wandering around the stage, taking pictures of the band, and I walked -- this was only rehearsal, and I could do that -- walked back behind the trumpet section, looked over Clarke's shoulder, and Clarke was drawing everybody in the band, but the trumpet's eye view. It's the way…
